$comment: Intended visual changes, allowed only while visual-reference.sha is the reference below; see lib/approvals.ts.

changes.reason: New states: the profile editor (existing profile, profile created at login, validation errors, a profile changed elsewhere meanwhile). The reference has no editor and shows the profile page.
The profile header has an 'Edit Profile' button, which moves the panels below it down.
The account menu was cut off by the header (overflow: hidden): it is now placed in the viewport and shows all three items; 'Modify Profile' opens the editor instead of being disabled.
